'''Steven Lewis Speederholics Anonymous''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Steven Lewis]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls137.htm Speederholics Anonymous], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041027134533/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls137.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
